name: io.github.neurarch-ai/neurarch-mcp
title: Neurarch
description: Pre-checks a model change before GPU time or traffic: memory, layout, serving config, pins.

packageArguments.description: Path to a PyTorch .py file or .neurarch.json graph, or zoo:<id> for a bundled reference architecture (examples/ in the repo)

packageArguments.name: --watch
packageArguments.description: Reload the model file when the Neurarch app saves it

packageArguments.name: --write
packageArguments.description: Expose the six mutation tools (off by default)

packageArguments.name: --hf
packageArguments.description: Allow hf:<org/name> refs and load_hf_model (reads config files from huggingface.co)

packageArguments.name: --tools=core
packageArguments.description: Advertise the core tools only; all stay callable
